notes: Self-hosted open-weight decision models: facts from model cards and HF metadata (not re-verified against code unless noted). Interfaces mostly mimic the TypeSafe /v1/systemone shape (decider-ai, Kev, Winnow, Xor, Jebadiah, JPT via llm2jev, Surogate /v1/decisions). Decider-2b/4b: choice up to 255 options, state up to 32,768 tokens in config, English only, Rules written into the question ("fill if empty, otherwise skip") "are not followed at this size"; one forward per question by default (independent=True) or packed (independent=False; reordering changed up to 12% of answers). Eikos-27B: up to 160 options in one pass (A-Z then AA...). Winnow-12B: 1-256 questions per request and 2-64 alternatives per question. Jet v6.2: prompts up to 16,384 tokens, never silently truncated; author says confidence is not calibrated. JPT: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial); one temperature fit on a held-out split; ECE 0.02-0.19 by task. Xor: up to 8 images or one video; body up to 8 MB. Other entrants (Kev, Jebadiah, Rune, JPT, Winnow...) have unknowns left null.

surfaces.notes: abstain_supported true only via a user-defined catch-all option ("chosen when nothing on offer fits, not when the exact fine-grained label is merely absent"); calibration_claimed null: per-type temperatures (v11: choice 1.164, noul 1.624, score 1.124) but the card reports overconfidence on hard items (ECE 0.156 held-out; 0.175 JevBench hard tier). English only. GGUF engine has no prefix cache; llama-server readout works with n_predict 1 and n_probs 100.
Same package and interface as decider-2b (v2.1 on Qwen3.5-4B-Base).

Up to 160 options in one pass; caller can abstain below a confidence threshold (no native unknown); text + images (serve v1.3, zero-shot via the base vision encoder); English and Portuguese trained. The board latency run used --max-model-len 65536 (a run setting, not stored as a model limit).

API.md: "There must be 1-256 questions and 2-64 alternatives per question" (en dashes in the source); up to 16 images (needs a matching --mmproj); /v1/systemone and /v1/chat/completions from one loaded model; requests processed one at a time.

"Questions are processed separately."; runtime accepts complete prompts up to 16,384 tokens and never silently truncates; the author states confidence is not calibrated; long-context quality not established.

CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial). Calibrated with one temperature (T=1.036 for 4B, 1.087 for 9B) on a held-out split; The card SGLang flags use --context-length 32768 (a serving flag, not stored as a model limit). Vision tower unchanged (images accepted).
Deterministic single-token candidate readout, forward+reverse option-order evaluation and calibration; up to 8 images or one video; request body <= 8 MB (HTTP 422 beyond).

README unreadable (HTTP 401, repo gated auto); interface unknown beyond POST /v1/decisions with "whole row in one request (shared state prefill)" and a 262,144 max-model-len used in the board latency run (third-party summary).
